integrity: Analytic proof supplied; exact and noninteger checks reproducible with checker.py; finite tests not a universal proof; no independent mathematical audit.
limitations: Applies to real affine L2 projection under strictly positive Dirichlet probability weights on simplices. Higher-degree, complex, singular and non-Dirichlet measures are not treated. Prior unweighted and atomic results are acknowledged. Published-source priority remains subject to unindexed stronger results.
source_ids: Waldron, Multivariate Jacobi polynomials with singular weights, Technical Report, 2007-02-13, https://www.math.auckland.ac.nz/~waldron/Preprints/Jacobi-singular/jacobi-singular.pdf
Hangelbroek et al., Kernel Approximation on Manifolds II, arXiv:1005.2424, first posted 2010-05-13
title: Least Dirichlet concentration controls sharp affine projection on every simplex
